text:
kiran: Quick kickoff — want to confirm scope for AWS/GCP/Azure listing onboarding. focus: account setup, SKU mapping, legal signoffs, and trial packaging. can we lock owners?

maya: +1. i'll own SKU mapping and trial packaging (pricing tiers + limits). will need input from legal on trial wording.

anna-legal: noted. i'll do a short checklist for the legal artifacts we need: EULA, SOC attestation, privacy snippets, and marketing copy approvals. estimated 3 business days once drafts arrive.

sam-eng: I'll handle IAM roles and publisher account automation. can we put the Terraform snippet we're using for role binders here? makes handoffs easier.

sam-eng: ```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "marketplace_publisher" {
  name = "redwood-marketplace-publisher-{{account}}"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.assume.json
}
```

kiran: perfect. maya, can you map SKU <-> product id matrix and share CSV by EOD? lucas-sales to confirm trial tiers.

lucas-sales: confirming 14-day trial + free tier (10k tokens/mo) and Standard paid tier. i'll share customer-facing names. :+1:

maya: starting CSV. one question: do we need separate listing artifacts per region (e.g., public AMIs for AWS)?

sam-eng: yes for AWS AMIs and GCP images we need region-specific IDs. i'll produce a script to verify AMI IDs.

sam-eng: ```bash
# verify AMI exists in region list
for r in us-east-1 us-west-2 eu-west-1; do
  aws ec2 describe-images --region $r --image-ids $AMI_ID || echo "missing $AMI_ID in $r"
done
```

anna-legal: also flagging that marketplace storefront descriptions must avoid certain compliance claims (no HIPAA statements without BAA). will annotate the copy.

devex: i can draft the quickstart listing doc for console + terraform snippets. will include a 'known-issues' section for image replication delays.

kiran: timeline proposal: 
- Day 0: kickoffs + owners (today)
- Day 1-2: SKU mapping + AMI/image verification
- Day 3: legal drafts completed
- Day 4: packaging artifacts assembled and test publish to staging
- Day 5: go/no-go and production publish

maya: tagged owners in the shared spreadsheet: https://docs.internal/redwood/marketplace-onboard (please add comments)

anna-legal: adding checklist items there now.

ops-bot: Reminder: create a staging publisher account in cloud-catalog-staging before Day 4.

sam-eng: noted. will run image verification and post results in this thread when done.

kiran: risks: legal signoff delays, AMI replication lag, and pricing tier wording. if anyone sees other blockers call them out now.

lucas-sales: potential blocker: channel partner co-branding approvals — i'll loop partner-legal if/when we need external logos.

maya: ok i'll include a "co-branding required" flag per SKU in the CSV.

kiran: thanks all. next sync if needed tomorrow 10am. if not, update the spreadsheet and ping this thread. :rocket:
